# LLM Resources

This section contains resources and documentation for LLM integration with the Context-Action framework.

## Available Resources

### Conventions
- [Conventions](./conventions.md) - Coding conventions and best practices for LLM integration

### Library Specifications
- [Library Specifications](./library-specs.md) - Technical specifications for library usage

### Generated Files
- **llms-500chars.txt** - 500 character summary for token-limited contexts
- **llms-minimal.txt** - Minimal essential information
- **llms-origin.txt** - Complete original documentation

## Purpose

These resources are designed to help LLMs understand and work effectively with the Context-Action framework, providing documentation at various levels of detail to fit different context requirements.
